# Play — Crossed Swords

- SudokuPad: [Crossed Swords on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Crossed Swords on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
f-puzzles has no battlefield constraint and no Dutch whisper, so the battlefield totals are drawn as cosmetic circles with the
total at the clue position, and all four lines as cosmetic lines (green blades, orange hilts). The apps won't enforce any of
them; the rules text covers them. I have not opened the links in a browser. If anything looks off, use `grid.svg` in this folder
as the reference picture.

German whispers (green blades): r1c1–r2c2–r3c3–r4c4–r5c5–r6c6–r7c7; r1c9–r2c8–r3c7–r4c6–r5c5–r6c4–r7c3.

Dutch whispers (orange hilts): r6c8–r7c7–r8c6; r7c7–r8c8–r9c9; r6c2–r7c3–r8c4; r7c3–r8c2–r9c1.

Battlefield clues: column 1: 1; column 3: 30; column 4: 35; row 1: 36; row 8: 37; row 9: 17.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
